headline: Yakumo Mount
title: Yakumo | Rideable Gatherer With a Passive Hunting Trick | Palworld Guide
video_script: Yakumo is a Neutral Pal you can ride. Its partner skill, Birds of a Feather, raises your chance of meeting Pals that carry the same passive skill while you fight together, by fifteen to thirty percent. That helps when you hunt for perfect passives. It also works at Gathering level two. Wild ones spawn near Dancing Sakura Shrine on Sakurajima, around level fifty three. Will you ride Yakumo? Comment below!

scenes.sub: More Pals with the same passive

description: Palworld 1.0 Yakumo guide: rideable Neutral Pal, Gathering level 2, partner skill Birds of a Feather and where it spawns on Sakurajima.
joke: Yakumo is a loyal dog that also happens to help you hunt for good genes.
